title: Product naming
text: Always write the product name as Lumina Glow Serum. Never abbreviate it as LGS or write it in lowercase.

title: Claims policy: efficacy
text: Efficacy claims need a cited clinical study on file before publication. Never use absolute wording such as 'all', 'always', 'guaranteed', '100%' or 'cure' in efficacy claims. Prefer wording such as 'visibly reduces the look of fine lines'.

title: Voice and tone
text: Our voice is warm, calm and expert. Avoid slang, hype and exclamation-heavy copy. Do not use fear-based messaging about ageing or appearance.

title: Required disclaimer
text: Every skincare social post that mentions results must include the disclaimer: 'Results vary by individual.'

title: Glow Serum price
text: Lumina Glow Serum 30 ml is priced at INR 1,499 as of October 2026.

title: Glow Serum key ingredients
text: Lumina Glow Serum contains 2% niacinamide and 0.5% hyaluronic acid. It is dermatologist tested on 40 volunteers over 4 weeks.

title: Company founding
text: Lumina Skincare was founded in Bengaluru in 2019.

title: Product naming
text: Always write the product name as Zenith Pro Max. Never use the word Lumina.
